import paramiko

# Use nohup and check logs
cmd = """export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
/opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Started: $!" """

time.sleep(30)

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -30 /tmp/gradle.log")

c.close()
EOF
